reason: I would download it because the small events are free and that is all I ever join anyway, but buying a 700 Lek concert ticket through an app is not something I do — that is real money for me and I pay cash when I pay at all.
objection: I have seen this before — an app launches, there are three events on it and nothing for me, like the government TEA app that died. Why would I check it instead of the Instagram stories and WhatsApp groups that already work?
would_change_my_mind: If I opened it and the free feed was actually full — hikes, chess, book clubs happening this weekend with people visibly joining — and there was a way to pay cash at the door for the rare big event, I might eventually buy one ticket.
